scheme_name: Tailoring Training To Scheduled Caste & Backward Classes Widows/Destitute Women/Girls
other_conditions: Applicant must be a widow, destitute woman, or girl.
benefits_summary: ₹600 per month stipend, ₹300 per month for raw materials, and a free sewing machine after course completion.
documents_required: Certificate signed by village Panch/Sarpanch confirming widow or destitute status
